vehicle: Tesla Model 3 Highland SOP9 LHD Base Audio (BAUDIO + TWTR)

optionCodeEvidence.origin: Source_Assets/core/audio_lhd.svg ORIGINAL Tesla electrical source drawing; individual wire elements have option_code attributes; do not use merged per-connector metadata without checking option_code
optionCodeEvidence.limitation: Tesla drawing option-code BAUDIO path verified. Correct vehicle year/harness population and connector mating orientation must still be verified in physical car. BAUDIO indicates wiring option not a measurement proving speaker isolation.

recommendedMethod: Reversible cabin-side connector interposer or professional automotive-grade breakout at the correct body-controller door-harness connector; intercept ONLY the downstream tweeter+/- conductor, leave factory/module tweeter source isolated and preserve all unrelated circuits with fully validated pass-throughs; no new speaker cables through the doors.

amplifier.activeWiring: Only after independent circuits are verified ISOLATED: physical H drives dedicated left tweeter and physical I drives dedicated right tweeter. Amplified A/B drive ONLY independently verified BAUDIO front woofers. Never tie H into A nor I into B, and never connect H/I to original Tesla source outputs.
amplifier.crossover: H and I: HP 3500 Hz LR24, LP off, starting gain -18 dB, muted until verified; A/B woofer only: HP 65 Hz LR24 and LP 250 Hz LR24 only after physical separation is confirmed.
amplifier.inputRouting: Front L Full from ISA verified A+C sources, Front R Full from ISA verified B+E sources; use VCP matching physical speakers only after measurement; initial filters can be set with outputs muted.

factoryPathNote: BAUDIO and PAUDIO paths can share downstream X922/X923 and X565/X575 endpoint pins but change upstream X033/X053 body-controller cavities. Do not infer option from Tesla body connector metadata alone.
forbidden: DO NOT use PAUDIO X033A-5/6 or X053A-22/23 in this BAUDIO circuit.
DO NOT connect HELIX H/I to Tesla module-side/MCU-side factory audio power outputs; only connect to isolated downstream tweeter wire pairs.
DO NOT splice into, modify, or drill OEM door gaiter; no new wires through door are required if all existing BAUDIO cavities are physically populated.
DO NOT disturb/depinn airbag, door pressure sensor, latch or window-control signals; multiway body-controller connectors carry safety-relevant circuits.
DO NOT treat the new Highland harness sleeve 'Front Low/TW' as proof of an actual electrical parallel joint; use continuity checks.
DO NOT connect speakers or energize outputs until HP3500 LR24 has been saved, and OEM source isolation and amplifier load and polarity pass QC.

installationGates.label: Confirm the actual vehicle/build is LHD Highland SOP9 BAUDIO and connectors X033B and X053A correspond to the factory door connectors.
Export/backup existing V TWELVE DSP settings; mute physical H/I and set their 3500 Hz LR24 protective HP.
Follow Tesla LV safe-isolation instructions before disconnecting any multiway body-controller connectors. Do not touch HV/orange cables or SRS hardware.

At X565 and X575, unplug each tweeter and continuity test to *vehicle-side* BAUDIO X033B-1/2 and X053A-5/6, respectively, with vehicle power isolated. Observe contact-face orientation and actual populated cavities.
Use a verified keyed reversible adapter at the correct cabin-side multiway connector, preserve all unrelated functions and insulate OEM audio source to prevent amplifier-to-amplifier backfeeding.
Verify no electrical continuity between H/I tweeter return network and A/B woofer return circuits, OEM amplifier sources, vehicle chassis or each other.
Check both woofer loops X568/X578 remain connected to A/B only, and tweeter loops X565/X575 to H/I only.
With outputs muted, program final physical A/B woofer HP65/LP250 and H/I tweeter HP3500 LP OFF at LR24, initial safe attenuations; only then conduct low-volume channel tests.
Reinstall trims without pinched conductors or cable runs in airbag deployment zones, seat tracks, pedal linkages or door hinges; inspect door electrical/window/pressure sensor diagnostics.

imageAvailability: OEM door and body controller connector location renders in repository. A validated 3D mesh showing the installer-added V TWELVE-to-under-dashboard cable path is NOT present; the cabin added path in viewer is an engineering proposal only, not Tesla factory routing.
